chapter: Teddy Wilson bands and Cafe Society
title: Cafe Society Downtown and Uptown acts
summary: The boogie-woogie pianists, Joe Turner and others at the downtown club and the uptown acts.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Okay, so now we are back to Cafe Society. Did you do both the Cafe Society?
Yeah, we left Downtown and went up to Uptown.
Downtown, we had the boogie-woogie pianists Pete Johnson and Albert Ammons and Joe Turner and a comedian, various ones, and then we went uptown we had Mildred Bailey, Savo --
Jimmy Savo, the boogie- woogie pianist, the Golden Gate quartet, they were downtown too.
Now, did you go back and forth between the two or did you just --
